description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tech(x) supports U.S. Army DEVCOM C5ISR Center programs and seeks an entry-level Android software developer. The role focuses on designing, building, integrating, and testing Android applications and software systems in a collaborative development environment.
Android application developer building, integrating, and testing mobile software with external APIs

Responsibilities:
• Design and build applications for the Android platform
• Develop software applications, services, and systems
• Integrate software components into a complex software development environment
• Collaborate with team members to review architecture designs, system requirements, and code
• Work with external data sources and APIs
• Unit test code for robustness, including edge cases, usability, and reliability
• And all other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• * One to two years of software development experience with a focus on Android; recent graduates are encouraged to apply
• * Programming in Java, Kotlin, or C/C++
• * Android development, including familiarity with the Android SDK, Android Studio, and the Android ecosystem
• * Strong communication skills, the ability to learn independently, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
• * U.S. citizenship
• * Active security clearance
• * Bachelor of Science or Master of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Mathematics
• * One to two years of Android focused software development experience; recent graduates may apply
• * Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland
• * Onsite support
• * Up to 5%

Preferred:
• * prior Department of Defense experience
• * Experience with Linux or Windows
• * Familiarity with web applications or microservices development
• * Familiarity with Army tactical equipment, including tactical radios, commercial off the shelf radios, handheld devices, and vehicle devices
• * Knowledge of network management protocols and data models
• * Familiarity with Agile software development processes
